text: If your face looks like this, if your belly looks like this, and if your arms look like this, you are not overweight. You are exhausted on the inside, and you have been this way for so long that you think it is normal. You wake up tired, you spend the day tired, and you go to bed tired, and it does not matter how much you sleep. The next day is the same. You think it is your age. You think it is work. You think it is because you do not eat well, or because you do not exercise, but it is none of that. What is happening to you is that your body has been running non-stop for years, and nobody taught you how to stop it. Think about how you live. You wake up already thinking about everything you have to do. You take care of everyone except yourself. You swallow what you feel, because there is no time to feel. You smile, even when you are falling apart. You push through, because that is what you have always done, and your body absorbs all of it. The anger you never express. The sadness you never release. The anxiety that has become your companion every single night. All of that, your body turns into exhaustion. Into bloating. Into back pain. Into hair that falls out. Into a belly that will not go down. Into insomnia. Into brain fog. Into wanting to cry for no reason. And what do most people do? They drink another coffee. Push through another day and keep going. But your body does not hold up forever. Every day you ignore the signals. The exhaustion goes deeper. And there comes a point where it is no longer tiredness. You are shutting down. What you need is not more sleep. Not another diet. Not another supplement. What you need is to learn how to release everything you have been accumulating. And give your body permission to truly recover. Write in the comments. Enough if you are tired of being tired. And if you want to learn how the connection between what you silence and what your body expresses really works. I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that. And everything I discovered is inside The Way Back to Stillness. The link is in my profile.
